name: How long does a minor home repair typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a minor home repair typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most minor home repairs can be completed within a few hours to a single day. The exact duration depends on the specific issue, its severity, and whether any specialized parts need to be ordered. For instance, fixing a running toilet might take an hour, while patching and painting a small section of drywall could take several hours due to drying times. A professional can provide a more accurate time estimate after assessing the repair.
